## Dependencies
```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Data
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
dsdn <- read.csv("../project_2/alphamissense/gene_results_with_am_significance.csv")
permut <- read.csv("./permutation_res_2000_subset.csv")
dndscv <- read.csv("./dndscv_significant_drivers.csv")

dsdn_df <- dsdn %>% 
  select(gene_name, significant, am_significant)

permut_df <- permut %>%
  mutate(gene_name = Hugo_Symbol) %>% 
  mutate(perm_significant = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, "True", "False")) %>% 
  select(gene_name, perm_significant)

cv_df <- dndscv %>%
  mutate(cv_significant = ifelse(qglobal_cv < 0.05, "True", "False")) %>%
  select(gene_name, cv_significant)

merged_df <- permut_df %>%
  full_join(dsdn_df,    by = "gene_name") %>%
  full_join(cv_df,      by = "gene_name")

## fill NA with False
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(perm_significant, significant, am_significant, cv_significant), 
                 ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "False", .)))
  
  
# Count how many TRUE’s each gene has across those four columns:
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(n_true = rowSums(across(c(perm_significant, significant, am_significant, cv_significant), 
                                      ~ . == "True")))

# Keep only genes with at least two TRUE’s, and pull the gene_name:
genes_consensus <- merged_df %>%
  filter(n_true >= 2) %>%
  pull(gene_name)
```

```{r}
MI_genes <- read.csv("./sig_mutations_driver_genes_MI.csv") %>%
  select(gene) %>% 
  rename(gene_name = gene)

intogen <- read.csv("./IntOGen-DriverGenes_LUAD.tsv", sep = "\t")
intogen <- intogen %>%
  select(Symbol) %>%
  rename(gene_name = Symbol)

# Union all
gene_final <- c(genes_consensus, MI_genes$gene_name, intogen$gene_name) %>%
  unique()
```

# OR intersect between any 2
```{r}
i1 <- intersect(genes_consensus, MI_genes$gene_name)
i2 <- intersect(genes_consensus, intogen$gene_name)
i3 <- intersect(MI_genes$gene_name, intogen$gene_name)

gene_final <- union(i1, union(i2, i3))
```

### feature
```{r}
mutation <- read.csv("../project_4/raw_mutations_PASS_only.csv.gz")
```

```{r}
# 1. Define non‐silent classifications (modify as needed)
nonsilent <- setdiff(unique(mutation$Variant_Classification), "Silent")

# 2. Filter to genes in gene_final and non‐silent mutations, then tally per patient/gene
tbl <- mutation %>%
  filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% gene_final,
         Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent) %>%
  count(patient_id, Hugo_Symbol)

# 3. Pivot to patient×gene matrix (fill missing with 0)
mat_df <- tbl %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Hugo_Symbol,
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0)

# 4. Turn into a matrix with patient_id as row names
mat <- mat_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
# ─── 1. Define thresholds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
min_mutations <- 5    # drop any gene whose total mutation count < 5
corr_cutoff   <- 0.90 # consider genes with pairwise correlation > 0.90 as “too collinear”

# ─── 2. Filter genes with too-few mutations ──────────────────────────────────
#    Keep only columns (genes) whose column‐sum ≥ min_mutations
mat2 <- mat[, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_mutations]

# ─── 3. Remove near-zero-variance genes ─────────────────────────────────────
#    (These are genes that are essentially constant across patients.)
library(caret)
nzv_idx <- nearZeroVar(mat2, saveMetrics = FALSE)
if (length(nzv_idx) > 0) {
  mat2 <- mat2[, -nzv_idx]
}

# ─── 4. Drop highly correlated (multicollinear) genes ────────────────────────
#    Compute pairwise Pearson correlations and remove one gene from each pair > corr_cutoff.
corr_matrix <- cor(mat2)
highCorr_idx <- findCorrelation(corr_matrix, cutoff = corr_cutoff, names = FALSE)

if (length(highCorr_idx) > 0) {
  mat2 <- mat2[, -highCorr_idx]
}

# ─── 5. Save the filtered matrix as CSV ─────────────────────────────────────
#    Rows are patients; columns are filtered genes.
write.csv(mat2,
          file = "./colinear_union_patient_gene_matrix.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

# write.csv(mat2,
#           file = "./intersect_union_patient_gene_matrix.csv",
#           row.names = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# ─── 1. Define thresholds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
min_mutations <- 5    # drop any gene whose total mutation count < 5
corr_cutoff   <- 0.90 # consider genes with pairwise correlation > 0.90 as “too collinear”

# ─── 2. Filter genes with too-few mutations ──────────────────────────────────
#    Keep only columns (genes) whose column‐sum ≥ min_mutations
mat2 <- mat[, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_mutations]

write.csv(mat2,
          file = "./full_union_patient_gene_matrix.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)
```
